LiteParse is a fast, open-source document parsing tool written in Rust, designed for efficient local processing of PDFs and other document types. It extracts text with bounding boxes, supports multiple OCR engines, generates screenshots, and outputs structured Markdown, JSON, or plain text, making it suitable for RAG pipelines and LLM agents.
